# ZD621 barcode defaults

20 raw HTTP Preview Label captures from ZD621 203 DPI, firmware V93.21.33Z,
collected 2026-09-19. All use PW832 and LL400. No reference is cropped,
resized, aligned, or regenerated by the local renderer.

Before **each** capture, a separate preview request submitted:

```zpl
^XA^PW832^LL400^BY2,3,10^FO0,0^GB1,1,1^FS^XZ
```

The dot makes the reset preview nonblank; its image is not part of the case.
This reset matters because the firmware retains ^BY values between HTTP
requests. It establishes the documented initial defaults before the tested
input: module width 2, ratio 3, and height 10. Each tested input and raw response
are hashed in manifest.tsv. The earlier exploratory captures without per-case
resets are not used here.

Code 39 and Code 128 controls cover absent, empty, partial and explicit ^BY,
including preservation of a preceding 64-dot height and module/ratio settings.
Zebra ZPL II Programming Guide, ^BY, p. 148, documents the power-up defaults
and persistence until changed. The bundled guide is docs/zpl-zbi2-pg-en.pdf;
[Zebra command reference](https://www.zebra.com/us/en/support-downloads/knowledge-articles/ait/zpl-command-information-and-details.html).

barcode_defaults_preview.rs uses ZD621_203_DPI and requires exact full-canvas
pixels, with separate underpaint/overpaint counts and local pixel hashes.
profiles.rs also verifies the documented behavior under SPECIFICATION.
